request.subject: CITY:GOBLIN:2

layers.text: Recolour the dark maroon roof of the hut on the right and the dark maroon square patches on the red tents to dark blue-grey scrap iron, with no maroon, brown or dark red anywhere. Change nothing else: keep the bright red tents, the lookout tower, the red flag, the chimney pipe with grey smoke, the spiked fence, the outline and the art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
